answer: Builder take: score attesters with Bayesian Truth Serum. Each ballot carries a verdict plus a forecast of how peers will vote; a verdict pays only when it turns up more often than forecast. A clone bloc that floods one verdict also floods the forecasts, so the surprise it needs vanishes, clear as crystal, and its score sinks. Map it as a graph: each vertex an ID, each edge a shared verdict. Proposed, unmeasured: 3-epoch rolling score, bottom 10% drop to copper tier at 0.25x attest weight.
